stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard load-replay [-h] [--day DAY]
                                     [--stalled-asks STALLED_ASKS]
                                     [--stalled-hours STALLED_HOURS]
                                     [--backlog-hours BACKLOG_HOURS]
                                     [--from-audit] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --day DAY             A UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the newest recorded
                        day; the last few days are kept)
  --stalled-asks STALLED_ASKS
                        Try another threshold: asks stalled
  --stalled-hours STALLED_HOURS
                        Try another threshold: hours without movement
  --backlog-hours BACKLOG_HOURS
                        Try another threshold: hours of moved asks in the
                        backlog test
  --from-audit          Rebuild the day from the audit log and its archives
                        even when the series holds it (a past day is rebuilt
                        this way when the series does not)
  --json
